title: Assessment
description: Structured product reading of one card: readiness, goal, expected behaviour, out-of-scope items, questions, assumptions, dependencies, criteria with their source, and carried clarifications.

ready.description: True when the assessor is confident in the outcome; false when human input is needed.

goal.description: One sentence: what the card is trying to achieve.

expected_behavior.description: What the user or system does / what changes; empty means only goal, no behaviour change.

out_of_scope.description: Things explicitly not in this card (e.g. refactoring, optimization, future feature).

questions.description: Clarifications needed from the human; only when ready is false.

assumptions.description: Decisions the assessor made for the human to correct on the issue (no model rewrite).

surface.description: A route, screen, command or API.

action.description: What the user or system does.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria in the blueprint criterion shape.

criteria_source.description: "card" when the card has criteria; "assessor" when drafted by the model.

question.description: The human's question posted to the issue.

answer.description: The human's answer; blank is treated as "not answered".

clarifications.description: Carried from the input for the architect to see context.

assessment_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of goal, expected_behavior, out_of_scope, criteria for de-duplication.
